Hi Shazam, nice to meet you!

It is hard to find illustrators that draw attractive man as you do, so I wanted to ask you for an illustration of my vtuber character, if possible. His name is Cóndor Q'hawaq.

Cóndor is a part-time shaman, part-time barista living in a magical hostel up in the Andes mountains. He is based on a very important bird for the Andes culture called Andean condor. The hostel magically changes places now and then in order to appear near mountaineers that seek spiritual or emotional help. Condor helps them become in touch with their inner self, allowing these people to heal from their wounds. Sometimes, Cóndor needs to fight evil spirits attached to these people in order to liberate them. For that, he transforms into a beast.

The mountains are usually snowy because he lives at 6000mts, where there is no vegetation. I'll add some reference pictures for the hostel so you can have an idea about the place.

Feel free to draw him how you feel.
